title: Sports, boxing, tennis and a coach who forbade smoking
summary: He gave up boxing for tennis and football, and a coach kept him from smoking to protect his wind.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Okay. Now, during this time that you were, well, accomplishing all of these things in music that we are focusing on, I still hear you talking about tennis and all of the other sports. And, I know at that time, you must have been doing it. What was it like, in all the other areas, the non-musical areas of your life when you were in school there at 7 and 8 and so on?
Well, it wasn't too much for me. It was like, I was, had fun with my coach (inaudible), you know. And so, it wasn't too
Well, when did you start picking up this interest in all of the sports?

Well, when I, I suppose when I got a little older. You know, when I could kind of handle some of the fellows. Like, I tried to box. You know. A fellow is boxing and he's hitting me in my stomach. [Laughter] I said well, that settles that. That was the end of my boxing career. I'll take up something else. You know? Why do I have to go through all of that. You know ,the pain.
At least the trumpet doesn't hit back all the time.

Right. Then, I went in for tennis. The tennis court was right across from my house. So, all I had to do, 5:00 in the morning, 6:00 in the morning, my barber's, at that time, son, he was a tennis player. We used to get out there and play, what, in the summertime, play up to 12:00 in the day. So, we had a

Well, before I went into the band room. I had a coach during that time. I used to play something like a little cards. At night he'd send for me to come out. I didn't know nothing about it. So, he taught me how.
And then, another thing he really stayed on me about which I never did was to not to smoke. You know, they didn't like the smoking. They didn't want all the boys who played athletics to smoke.

So, he'd say we want your wind. We want your wind. I said well, if I need my wind doing this, I need my wind in my music. So, at that time, I just never bothered all through those years. And the way things are going now, the way people are trying to stop, I really appreciate what he did for me.
